plugins.label: Holographic DNA
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Vertical double-helix DNA strand with holographic glow, rotating rungs, and soft neon trails. Fully procedural Cairo drawing.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local cx = {cx}
local y0 = {y}
local H = {height}
local amp = {amplitude}
local turns = {turns}
local n_rung = math.max(2, math.floor({rung_count}))
local spin = {spin_speed} * wall_clock()
local ar, ag, ab = {color_a}
local br, bg, bb = {color_b}
local rr, rg, rb = {rung_color}
local glow = {glow}
local lw = {line_width}
local opacity = {opacity}
local steps = math.max(40, math.floor(H / 3))

local function helix_xy(t, phase)
  local ang = t * turns * 2 * math.pi + spin + phase
  local x = cx + math.cos(ang) * amp
  local y = y0 + t * H
  local z = math.sin(ang)
  return x, y, z
end

-- soft vertical aura
if glow then
  for g = 3, 1, -1 do
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.04 / g))
    cairo_set_line_width(cr, amp * 0.35 * g)
    cairo_move_to(cr, cx, y0)
    cairo_line_to(cr, cx, y0 + H)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
end

-- rungs (base pairs) — draw first so strands sit on top
for i = 0, n_rung - 1 do
  local t = (i + 0.5) / n_rung
  local x1, y1, z1 = helix_xy(t, 0)
  local x2, y2, z2 = helix_xy(t, math.pi)
  local depth = (z1 + z2) * 0.5
  local a = opacity * (0.35 + 0.55 * (0.5 + 0.5 * depth))
  if glow then
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, rg, rb, a * 0.35)
    cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 2.2)
    cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1)
    cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, rg, rb, a)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 0.85)
  cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1)
  cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
  -- nucleotide dots
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, a)
  cairo_arc(cr, x1, y1, lw * 1.1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, br, bg, bb, a)
  cairo_arc(cr, x2, y2, lw * 1.1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
end

-- strand polylines (back-to-front by sampling depth)
local function draw_strand(phase, cr_, cg_, cb_)
  -- collect points
  local pts = {}
  for i = 0, steps do
    local t = i / steps
    local x, y, z = helix_xy(t, phase)
    pts[#pts + 1] = {x, y, z}
  end
  -- glow pass
  if glow then
    cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
    for g = 2, 1, -1 do
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, cr_, cg_, cb_, opacity * (0.12 / g))
      cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * (2.8 + g))
      cairo_new_path(cr)
      for i, p in ipairs(pts) do
        if i == 1 then cairo_move_to(cr, p[1], p[2]) else cairo_line_to(cr, p[1], p[2]) end
      end
      cairo_stroke(cr)
    end
  end
  -- main strand with depth-modulated alpha segments
  cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw)
  for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
    local a = opacity * (0.45 + 0.55 * (0.5 + 0.5 * pts[i][3]))
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, cr_, cg_, cb_, a)
    cairo_move_to(cr, pts[i][1], pts[i][2])
    cairo_line_to(cr, pts[i + 1][1], pts[i + 1][2])
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
end

draw_strand(0, ar, ag, ab)
draw_strand(math.pi, br, bg, bb)

plugins.label: Neon Geometry
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Neon-outlined shape that morphs between circle, square, triangle, star, and hexagon. Morph slider (0–1) blends vertices like a procedural shape interpolator; optional auto-morph over time. Multi-pass glow for a true neon look.

properties.label: Morph (0–1)
properties.help: 0 = shape A, 1 = shape B. In-between values blend vertex positions. Similar idea to continuous spiral/dash morphing.

properties.label: Auto-morph over time
properties.help: When on, Morph is ignored and the shape oscillates A↔B using Morph speed.

plugins.lua_helpers:
local function _neon_shape_pts(name, n, R)
  -- return list of {x,y} unit-ish points around origin for shape name
  local pts = {}
  name = tostring(name or 'circle')
  if name == 'circle' then
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local a = -math.pi / 2 + i * (2 * math.pi / n)
      pts[#pts + 1] = {math.cos(a) * R, math.sin(a) * R}
    end
  elseif name == 'square' or name == 'diamond' then
    local rot = (name == 'diamond') and (math.pi / 4) or (math.pi / 4 + 0) -- square aligned via 45 offset compensated below
    -- axis-aligned square via 4 corners sampled densely
    local corners = {
      {R, R}, {R, -R}, {-R, -R}, {-R, R}
    }
    if name == 'diamond' then
      corners = {{0, R}, {R, 0}, {0, -R}, {-R, 0}}
    else
      -- flat-top square
      corners = {{R * 0.75, R * 0.75}, {R * 0.75, -R * 0.75}, {-R * 0.75, -R * 0.75}, {-R * 0.75, R * 0.75}}
    end
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local seg = t * 4
      local si = math.floor(seg) % 4
      local f = seg - math.floor(seg)
      local c0, c1 = corners[si + 1], corners[(si + 1) % 4 + 1]
      pts[#pts + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
    end
  elseif name == 'triangle' then
    local corners = {}
    for i = 0, 2 do
      local a = -math.pi / 2 + i * (2 * math.pi / 3)
      corners[#corners + 1] = {math.cos(a) * R, math.sin(a) * R}
    end
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local seg = t * 3
      local si = math.floor(seg) % 3
      local f = seg - math.floor(seg)
      local c0, c1 = corners[si + 1], corners[(si + 1) % 3 + 1]
      pts[#pts + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
    end
  elseif name == 'star' then
    local points = 5
    local inner = R * 0.42
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local ang = -math.pi / 2 + t * 2 * math.pi
      -- distance oscillates outer/inner
      local wave = (math.cos(ang * points) + 1) * 0.5
      local rad = inner + (R - inner) * wave
      -- sharper star via power
      local sharp = math.abs(math.cos(ang * points))
      rad = inner + (R - inner) * (sharp ^ 1.6)
      pts[#pts + 1] = {math.cos(ang) * rad, math.sin(ang) * rad}
    end
  elseif name == 'hexagon' then
    local corners = {}
    for i = 0, 5 do
      local a = -math.pi / 2 + i * (math.pi / 3)
      corners[#corners + 1] = {math.cos(a) * R, math.sin(a) * R}
    end
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local seg = t * 6
      local si = math.floor(seg) % 6
      local f = seg - math.floor(seg)
      local c0, c1 = corners[si + 1], corners[(si + 1) % 6 + 1]
      pts[#pts + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
    end
  elseif name == 'octagon' then
    local corners = {}
    for i = 0, 7 do
      local a = -math.pi / 8 + i * (math.pi / 4)
      corners[#corners + 1] = {math.cos(a) * R, math.sin(a) * R}
    end
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local t = i / n
      local seg = t * 8
      local si = math.floor(seg) % 8
      local f = seg - math.floor(seg)
      local c0, c1 = corners[si + 1], corners[(si + 1) % 8 + 1]
      pts[#pts + 1] = {c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * f, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * f}
    end
  else
    for i = 0, n - 1 do
      local a = -math.pi / 2 + i * (2 * math.pi / n)
      pts[#pts + 1] = {math.cos(a) * R, math.sin(a) * R}
    end
  end
  return pts
end
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
local morph = {morph}
if {auto_morph} then
  local t = wall_clock() * {morph_speed}
  morph = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi)
end
morph = clamp(tonumber(morph) or 0, 0, 1)
-- smoothstep for nicer blend
local m = morph * morph * (3 - 2 * morph)
local rot = math.rad({rotation_speed} * wall_clock())
local nr, ng, nb = {color}
local opacity = {opacity}
local lw = {line_width}
local layers = math.max(0, math.floor({glow_layers}))
local do_fill = {fill}
local N = 64

local a_pts = _neon_shape_pts({shape_a}, N, R)
local b_pts = _neon_shape_pts({shape_b}, N, R)

cairo_save(cr)
cairo_translate(cr, cx, cy)
cairo_rotate(cr, rot)

cairo_new_path(cr)
for i = 1, N do
  local ax, ay = a_pts[i][1], a_pts[i][2]
  local bx, by = b_pts[i][1], b_pts[i][2]
  local x = ax + (bx - ax) * m
  local y = ay + (by - ay) * m
  if i == 1 then cairo_move_to(cr, x, y) else cairo_line_to(cr, x, y) end
end
cairo_close_path(cr)

if do_fill then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, opacity * 0.12)
  cairo_fill_preserve(cr)
end

-- neon glow passes (stroke_preserve)
cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
for i = layers, 1, -1 do
  local spread = lw + i * (lw * 0.85)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, spread)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, opacity * (0.14 / i))
  cairo_stroke_preserve(cr)
end

-- core bright stroke
cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw)
cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, opacity * 0.9)
cairo_stroke_preserve(cr)
cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw * 0.55)
cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, opacity)
cairo_stroke(cr)

cairo_restore(cr)

plugins.label: Spinning Globe
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Animated Earth globe with latitude/longitude grid and simplified continents. Choose holographic wireframe or classroom solid style, set axial tilt, and spin speed (deg/sec). Fully procedural — no image assets required.

properties.label: Style
properties.help: Holographic: cyan wire grid + glow. Classroom: filled oceans/land with soft shading.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
local opacity = {opacity}
local style = {style}
local tilt = math.rad({tilt_deg})
local spin = math.rad({spin_speed}) * wall_clock()
local ar, ag, ab = {color}
local or_, og, ob = {ocean_color}
local show_grid = {show_grid}
local show_land = {show_continents}

-- Sphere fill (classroom) or soft disc (holographic)
if style == 'classroom' then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, or_, og, ob, opacity * 0.95)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  -- soft limb darkening
  local _g = cairo_pattern_create_radial(cx - R * 0.25, cy - R * 0.25, R * 0.1, cx, cy, R)
  cairo_pattern_add_color_stop_rgba(_g, 0, or_ * 1.15, og * 1.15, ob * 1.1, opacity * 0.35)
  cairo_pattern_add_color_stop_rgba(_g, 1, 0, 0, 0, opacity * 0.55)
  cairo_set_source(cr, _g)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  cairo_pattern_destroy(_g)
else
  -- holographic outer glow
  for i = 3, 1, -1 do
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.06 / i))
    cairo_set_line_width(cr, i * 2.2)
    cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R + i * 1.5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar * 0.15, ag * 0.25, ab * 0.35, opacity * 0.25)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
end

-- Project lon/lat (degrees) → screen after spin + tilt; returns sx,sy,visible
local function project(lon_d, lat_d)
  local lon = math.rad(lon_d) + spin
  local lat = math.rad(lat_d)
  local x = math.cos(lat) * math.sin(lon)
  local y = math.sin(lat)
  local z = math.cos(lat) * math.cos(lon)
  x, y, z = _globe_rot_x(x, y, z, tilt)
  if z < -0.02 then return nil end
  local sx = cx + x * R
  local sy = cy - y * R
  return sx, sy, z
end

if show_land then
  for _, p in ipairs(_GLOBE_LAND) do
    local sx, sy, z = project(p[1], p[2])
    if sx then
      local pr = R * 0.055 * p[3] * (0.55 + 0.45 * z)
      if style == 'classroom' then
        cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.55 + 0.4 * z))
      else
        cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.35 + 0.5 * z))
      end
      cairo_arc(cr, sx, sy, pr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
      cairo_fill(cr)
    end
  end
end

if show_grid then
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, style == 'holographic' and 1.1 or 0.8)
  -- meridians
  for m = 0, 11 do
    local lon0 = m * 30
    cairo_new_path(cr)
    local started = false
    for lat = -85, 85, 4 do
      local sx, sy, z = project(lon0, lat)
      if sx then
        if not started then cairo_move_to(cr, sx, sy); started = true
        else cairo_line_to(cr, sx, sy) end
      else
        started = false
      end
    end
    if style == 'holographic' then
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.45)
    else
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, opacity * 0.22)
    end
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
  -- parallels
  for lat = -60, 60, 30 do
    cairo_new_path(cr)
    local started = false
    for lon = 0, 360, 4 do
      local sx, sy, z = project(lon, lat)
      if sx then
        if not started then cairo_move_to(cr, sx, sy); started = true
        else cairo_line_to(cr, sx, sy) end
      else
        started = false
      end
    end
    if style == 'holographic' then
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.4)
    else
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, opacity * 0.18)
    end
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
end

-- limb / outline
cairo_set_line_width(cr, style == 'holographic' and 1.6 or 1.2)
if style == 'holographic' then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.85)
else
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar * 0.5, ag * 0.5, ab * 0.5, opacity * 0.5)
end
cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
cairo_stroke(cr)

-- holographic scanline shimmer
if style == 'holographic' then
  local t = wall_clock()
  local band = (math.sin(t * 2.2) * 0.5 + 0.5) * R * 1.6 - R * 0.3
  cairo_save(cr)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R - 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_clip(cr)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.12)
  cairo_rectangle(cr, cx - R, cy - R + band, R * 2, 6)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  cairo_restore(cr)
end
